name: Disco Elysium
overview: Disco Elysium is a critically acclaimed, narrative-driven isometric role-playing game developed by ZA/UM and released in 2019. Widely considered one of the best-written video games ever made, it completely eschews traditional combat in favor of text-heavy dialogue, deep psychological exploration, and tabletop RPG mechanics.
